item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 27/Feb/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Fine and dry weather will persist over the coast of Guangdong in the next few days. Under the influence of a fresh to strong northeast monsoon, it will be windy with rather cool mornings over the region today and tomorrow. The monsoon is expected to moderate midweek this week, temperatures over the coast of Guangdong will rise slightly. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large in the following few days over the region.

Temp range: 14 - 20 C
R.H. range: 45 - 75 per Cent
